title: Avila Beach Whale Watching

services.name: Our boats, 28ft Power Catamarans
services.desc: We only use the best 28 FT power catamarans as they offer a much smoother ride than conventional boats and are more stable when we stop to observe wildlife. Everyone that has stepped aboard has mentioned the fantastic ride that these boats are famous for. When the wind picks up and the waves begin to build is were her design and solid construction really show. We literally slice through the waves which gives one the feeling of flying over the water. This smooth ride allows us to travel fast and have more quality time with the whales! The Boats are well maintained and have comfortable custom seating for 6. They are powered by a pair of new 150 hp ultra low emission motors. The Glacier Bay

blurb: Avila Beach Whale Watching offers wonderful family oriented boat tours in San Luis Obispo California . Experience the best whale watching California has to offer as we have whales here year round. We also offer natural history and wildlife viewing tours with a wonderful family atmosphere as we explore the coast in our 28ft power catamaran. All boating tours are semi private with only 6 passengers aboard at a time.
